item.title: Supreme Court Restores Injunction on California’s Gender-Secrecy School Policy
item.description: Supreme Court Restores Injunction on California’s Gender-Secrecy School Policy The U.S. Supreme Court restored the rights and authority of parents Monday by ruling that California schools can no longer secretly gender-transition students. In its ruling, the High Court restored an injunction against California school policy - which prohibits disclosure of students’ school-time gender identities to parents - granted in the case of parents and teachers challenging the school policy in Mirabelli v.
